purpose: Deterministic accounting-state classification for V4-A PIT historical qualification; not a predictive model.
comparable_period_rule: Same report-period end exactly one calendar year earlier, selected only from versions available by the current evidence_available_date.
data_insufficient_conditions: Any required current or prior-comparable fact is missing.
Any required fact lacks immutable document/revision/provenance identity.
The current or prior filing cannot be parsed without inference, unit guessing, interpolation, forward-fill, backfill, or current-snapshot substitution.
The comparable period or source window is incomplete.
A duplicate/conflicting identity or replay/revision audit fails.

fail_rules_in_priority_order.rationale: An officially reported current-period loss is explicit adverse fundamental evidence; no return-optimized magnitude threshold is used.

fail_rules_in_priority_order.condition: current revenue < prior revenue AND current net profit < prior net profit AND current operating cash flow < prior operating cash flow AND current net profit margin < prior net profit margin
fail_rules_in_priority_order.rationale: All four frozen accounting dimensions deteriorate versus the exact prior comparable period; only direction, not optimized magnitude, is used.

fail_rules_in_priority_order.condition: current net profit > 0 AND current operating cash flow < 0 AND prior operating cash flow >= 0 AND current operating cash flow < prior operating cash flow
fail_rules_in_priority_order.rationale: Positive reported profit accompanied by a newly negative and deteriorating operating cash-flow position is explicit earnings-quality deterioration.

fail_rules_in_priority_order.condition: current net profit < prior net profit AND current net profit margin < prior net profit margin AND current operating cash flow < prior operating cash flow
fail_rules_in_priority_order.rationale: Profit, profitability, and operating cash-flow all deteriorate; no percentage threshold is selected from outcomes.

pass_rule.condition: current net profit > 0 AND current operating cash flow >= 0 AND current revenue >= prior revenue AND current net profit >= prior net profit AND current operating cash flow >= prior operating cash flow AND current net profit margin >= prior net profit margin
pass_rule.rationale: PASS requires complete qualified evidence, positive profit/cash generation, and no deterioration in any frozen core accounting dimension. Absence of captured negatives alone is never PASS.

watch_rule.condition: All required evidence is complete and qualified, but neither any FAIL rule nor the PASS rule applies.
watch_rule.rationale: WATCH represents genuinely mixed accounting evidence and must never substitute for missing data.

revision_semantics: Append-only. A later restatement can change states only on or after its own evidence_available_date and must never rewrite an earlier as-of state.
threshold_policy: No historical-return threshold search. V1 uses sign and exact directional comparisons only.
